title: rinsing a brush at an art class

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Where can I rinse this paintbrush?
turns.zh: 我可以在哪裡沖洗這支畫筆？

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A. We keep spare brushes downstairs. B. Use the sink by the door. C. The blue paint is dry.
turns.zh: A. 備用畫筆放在樓下。 B. 用門旁的水槽。 C. 藍色顏料已經乾了。
